scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
We High Wizards have
the responsibility of
using our destructive magic
for the right purposes.
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
我们超魔导士有责任
将破坏性的魔法
用于正当的用途。

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
A lifetime of training
is required before becoming
a High Wizard. Can you imagine
what would happen if our power
was placed in the wrong hands?!
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
成为超魔导士需要
终生的训练。你能想象
如果我们的力量
落入错误的人手中
会发生什么吗？！

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
It is time.
And Midgard has
need of those who can
wield the strongest of magic...
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
时候到了。
米德加尔特需要
能够驾驭最强魔法的人...

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Would you like to
become a High Wizard?
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
你想成为
超魔导士吗？

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honors to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
当你准备好的时候，
请随时回来。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
你仍然可以学习更多技能。请在
回来之前使用完
所有剩余的技能点。

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Congratulations.
As a High Wizard,
I hope use you use
your powers to bring
peace to the oppressed.
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
恭喜。
作为超魔导士，
我希望你能
利用你的力量
为受压迫者带来和平。

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
欢迎来到
英灵殿，
荣耀之厅。

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
请在这里
好好休息。
向勇士们致敬！
